conflicts.kind: SPI1_RX contention: the cell monitor barrier's reverse channel is not tri-stated
conflicts.description: GPIO 8 (SPI1_RX of the measurement coprocessor) is one net shared by the ADS1235IRHBR (CS GPIO 9), the MAX31856MUD+T (CS GPIO 13) and, across the barrier, the ADBMS1818ASWAZ-RL (CS GPIO 15). assumptions.value: 2 PIO state machines on the measurement coprocessor, both in PIO1: 1 receive and 1 transmit, 13 instruction words (UART receive 9 + transmit 4, sized from the pico-examples UART programs, which are not in the tree); one receiver input on GPIO 23 (V68); the receive program takes the S.BUS 8E2 100 kbaud frame with the pad's input inversion, and the other buses (iBUS, SUMD, CRSF, SRXL2, JETI EX Bus) as UART; the transmit state machine drives GPIO 23 through SN74LVC1T45DBVR, whose direction pin takes 1 more GPIO (counted in GPIO: measurement). A hardware UART is available for the receive-only buses: UART1 is free on this chip and GPIO 23 has UART1_RX (funcsel 0x0b), but UART1_TX would need GPIO 20, 22, 24 or 26, which the encoder, a chip select and the TCA9548A reset hold, so the transmit direction needs PIO.
assumptions.why: No receiver PIO program is written (docs/Receivers.md); V71 (owner, 2026-09-28) says the bench transmits on a receiver input for JETI EX Bus and SRXL2; the map puts the receiver on PIO1; the count must be stated, and the count for transmit is the smallest that meets V71.

assumptions.value: 2 PIO state machines and 13 words (transmit 4 + receive 9, assumed) for a port in a programming mode, on the main coprocessor, bound before ports 1 to 4, the socket and PPM (V330): a port enters a programming mode with the port released; a mode change that cannot keep that order rebinds every output from scratch with the outputs stopped. With that order 223 of the 256 mixes bind, all 4 ports in programming mode take 11 of 12 state machines and 69 words, and 33 mixes are refused (see combinations). The one-wire bootloader (BLHeli_S and AM32, 19,200 baud, half duplex), the ESCape32 CLI and Hitec D-series run as PIO UART programs; VESC's 115,200 baud runs on UART1 (GPIO 4, 5, V67), not on a state machine. The measurement chip has none.
assumptions.why: No programmer protocol has run on a wire (STATUS.md, shared/ui/programmer_screen.c:237-248), the levels, form and baud of Hitec D-series and the ESCape32 baud are not stated (V59 to V62, V60 answered 'not known'), and each bound output loads its own copy of its program, so a count has to be assumed; pico-sdk 2.3.0 reserves nothing per port, which V330 answers with the bind order.

assumptions.value: 5 ms (a 200 Hz current sensor): the measurement coprocessor reads each INA3221 and checks the 3.0 A ceiling at every sample; the INA3221 refreshes its 3 channels in 3.63 ms at most in shunt-only mode, so each channel gives a fresh value at every 5 ms sample.
assumptions.why: The tree does not state the period of the coprocessor's port-current sample; docs/Servo.md:35 says 'checked at every sample' and the host test models the sensor at 5 ms. An earlier P5 assumed 20 ms, the BENCH sampling period, which its critic rejected: that period belongs to the motor monitor's BENCH reading.
